activity_closure.premise: The Fincham-Richardson dissolution relations give both dissolved sulfur species as proportional to sqrt(fS2) at fixed temperature, melt composition, and fO2.
activity_closure.algebra: log10[S2-] = log10(CS2-) + 0.5(log10(fS2)-log10(fO2)); log10[S6+] = log10(CS6+) + 0.5log10(fS2) + 1.5log10(fO2). Therefore log10(fS2) = 2(log10(S_total,wt%) - log10(10^(log10(CS2-)-0.5log10(fO2)) + 10^(log10(CS6+)+1.5log10(fO2)))).
activity_closure.units_check: Both capacities and S_total are wt% S; oxide fractions are dimensionless; fS2 and fO2 are fugacity ratios to the 1-bar gas standards. The resulting activity is the dimensionless ratio fS2/(1 bar).
